name: codex-beeper
description: Plays a desktop sound when Codex finishes a task or requires user input.

codexBeeper.codexHome.description: Path to the Codex home directory. Empty means ~/.codex.

codexBeeper.beepOnTaskComplete.description: Play a sound when the main Codex agent completes a task.

codexBeeper.beepOnApprovalRequest.description: Play a sound when Codex requires manual approval or other user input. Automatically approved actions stay silent.

codexBeeper.showNotifications.description: Show VS Code notifications alongside sounds.

codexBeeper.customSoundCommand.description: Optional shell command used for approval sounds and as a fallback when no completion sound file is selected. Empty uses platform defaults.

codexBeeper.completionSoundFile.markdownDescription: Audio file used when Codex completes a request. The selected file is copied into VS Code-managed extension storage, so moving or deleting the original does not affect playback. [Select an audio file…](command:codexBeeper.selectCompletionSound) Clear this setting to use the default sound.

codexBeeper.volumePercent.description: Playback volume for built-in sound commands.

codexBeeper.scanIntervalMs.description: Polling interval for Codex session logs.
